baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired first-person plurals in "نُنَجِّى" and "نَذَرُ," joined by "و," divide people within the same "فِيهَا."
baseline_models.mechanism: Rescue works as separation from a shared field: self-protective guarding supplies the criterion, one group is extracted, and the other is deliberately left immobilized.

activation_trace.role: Rescue by separation supplies the extracting operation.
Putting oneself within protection supplies the differentiating disposition.
Leaving something in place supplies the retained side of the sorting.
Kneeling supplies the bodily constraint of those who remain.

changed_reading.before: The ayah states two unrelated outcomes: salvation for one class and punishment for another.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts one differential operation inside a shared danger: extract the guarded, retain the wrongdoers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ" is immediately governed by "نَذَرُ" and completed by the locative-predicative "فِيهَا جِثِيًّا."
baseline_models.mechanism: Those characterized by putting things outside their proper place or withholding what is due undergo a reversal: they are themselves left fixed in an imposed place and posture.

activation_trace.role: Misplacing a thing supplies the spatial offense reversed by imposed placement.
Withholding from a right supplies the social detention reversed upon the wrongdoers.
Deliberate leaving supplies their imposed retention.
Kneeling makes the reversal bodily and spatially visible.

changed_reading.before: "Wrongdoers" is only a broad moral label, and kneeling is generic humiliation.
changed_reading.after: The clause enacts measure-for-measure placement: agents of displacement or withheld right are left unable to choose place or posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier chain makes the final division path-dependent: a successor-state deteriorates, prayer is let slip, desire is tracked, and the path terminates in a ruinous encounter.

activation_trace.role: A state changing toward corruption supplies the trajectory's degraded starting condition.
Loss and disappearance supply the failed maintenance of prayer.
Following in another's track supplies directional persistence toward desire.
A hunter's ruinous pit supplies the terminal image of the pursued course.

structural_cues: 19:59 orders deterioration, squandering, following, and encounter as a verbal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered losses and pursuit; I read the order as a formative arrow toward being left in 19:72. A live alternative is accumulation without strict causation.

changed_reading.before: The two classes in 19:72 appear as static identities.
changed_reading.after: At least the wrongdoer-class is shown as the endpoint of maintained direction: what one keeps following determines where one is finally left.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exception and repair sequence before the focus turns the boundary from hereditary essence into a traversable moral process, culminating in entry, inheritance, and the same protective root used in 19:72.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption supplies the reversible turn in the trajectory.
Entry into an interior supplies movement across the outcome boundary.
Bestowal without contract supplies the positive allocation reached after repair.
The protective state names the inheritor before becoming the rescued class in 19:72.

structural_cues: 19:60 opens with an exception and sequences turning, faith, and reparative action.
19:63 identifies the inheritor by the same و ق ي root that identifies the rescued in 19:72.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exception, repair, entry, inheritance, and repeated و ق ي; I infer a traversable category boundary. The live alternative is that the passage lists correlated marks without specifying formation.

changed_reading.before: Those guarded and those wronging are fixed populations disclosed only at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The rescued designation is the matured state of a repairable trajectory, while the final separation remains exact.

context_deltas.mechanism: A promised event comes, action descends by command, and the Lord is explicitly not neglectful; this constrains "نَذَرُ" to purposeful retention rather than accidental abandonment.

activation_trace.role: A promise fixed to an occasion supplies scheduled fulfillment.
Arrival supplies fulfillment rather than indefinite deferral.
Binding command supplies governed execution.
Neglectful leaving is explicitly negated, distinguishing it from deliberate retention.
The focus verb supplies the leaving whose agency is sharpened by the context.

structural_cues: 19:61 predicates actual arrival of the promise; 19:64 pairs command-governed descent with denial of forgetfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fulfillment, command, and negated neglect; I infer that the focus leaving is an adjudicated placement. The live alternative is that 19:64's denial of forgetting has only local scope.

changed_reading.before: "We leave" can sound like mere non-rescue or abandonment.
changed_reading.after: "We leave" is an intentional, remembered component of the same administered sorting as rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact kneeling root and form already accompany collective gathering and presentation around the destination in 19:68; 19:72 then removes one class while the other remains in that prior posture.

activation_trace.role: Driving and collecting a group supplies the common assembly stage.
Near, witnessed presence supplies formal presentation at that stage.
The surrounding relation locates the gathered field.
The same kneeling image establishes posture before the focus differentiation.
Separation-based rescue supplies removal from the already assembled field.
Repeated kneeling marks continuity for those not removed.

structural_cues: 19:66-68 moves from the resurrection question to collective gathering, presentation, and kneeling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective gathering plus repeated kneeling; I infer a shared pre-sort posture carried forward for those left. A live alternative is that 19:68's pronoun has a narrower group than 19:71's universal wording.

changed_reading.before: Kneeling is first imposed in 19:72 as the wrongdoers' exclusive final punishment.
changed_reading.after: Kneeling is already the assembly posture; the decisive penalty in 19:72 is remaining there after others are extracted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence first pulls the most defiant from each faction and identifies those most entitled to the fire, then 19:72 rescues the guarded; the scene behaves like successive opposed selections rather than one undifferentiated split.

activation_trace.role: Pulling something from its settled place supplies the first extraction operation.
A mutually supporting faction supplies the groups from which exemplars are drawn.
Defiance from obedience supplies the negative selection criterion.
Priority and entitlement supply rank within exposure.
Meeting the fire's heat supplies the ranked destination.
Rescue by separation supplies the opposed extraction of the guarded.

structural_cues: 19:69-70 uses "from every faction," two superlatives, and then 19:72's rescue-leave contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pulling, factional distribution, ranked entitlement, and later rescue; I infer sequential triage with opposite selection criteria. The live alternative is rhetorical ranking without a literal multi-pass procedure.

changed_reading.before: 19:72 performs a single flat binary separation.
changed_reading.after: 19:72 completes a layered sorting process: defiance is first exposed from within factions, then protective disposition governs extraction from the common field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal arrival is made binding and decisively enacted immediately before "then We rescue"; rescue therefore follows common approach or exposure rather than preventing it.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a thing supplies the universally shared approach.
Binding, settled judgment removes an avoidance reading.
A decisive enacted ruling supplies completion of the universal condition.
Separation-based rescue follows rather than cancels the shared arrival.
Leaving distinguishes continued exposure from extraction.

structural_cues: 19:71's universal construction is followed directly by 19:72's "ثُمَّ".
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal arrival, binding decree, and subsequent rescue; I infer rescue after shared exposure. The live alternative is that arrival need not specify entry, duration, or identical intensity.

changed_reading.before: Rescue means the guarded never approach the danger.
changed_reading.after: Rescue is separation after a universally mandated approach; the contrast is not encounter versus no encounter but removal versus remaining.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claims of better station and assembly are answered by destroyed predecessors with superior furnishings and appearance, while extension only delays disclosure; kneeling becomes a public reversal of social placement, not merely private pain.

activation_trace.role: Established residence or station supplies the prestige claim reversed by being left in place.
The assembled social club supplies the public arena of comparison.
Falling into destruction breaks the inference from visible prestige to final standing.
Abundant furnishings supply the material status that proves non-protective.
Visible appearance supplies the outward metric overturned by the focus posture.
Extended time supplies a provisional interval in which false status can persist.
Kneeling supplies the final bodily inversion of claimed standing.

structural_cues: 19:73 compares two groups by station and assembly; 19:74 counters with destroyed groups once superior in furnishings and appearance.
19:75 treats apparent advantage as an extension ending when the promised event is seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparative status, public assembly, superior display, destruction, and extension; I infer that kneeling stages their social reversal. The live alternative is that the comparisons criticize evidence rather than define the posture.

changed_reading.before: "جِثِيًّا" describes only fear or physical subjection.
changed_reading.after: Kneeling visibly reverses the boast of superior station and assembly: those who claimed the better place are the ones left without standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance increases, reparative deeds endure, and recompense returns to the agent; the focus designation "those who guarded" is thus the accumulated orientation whose consequence returns as rescue.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply a non-static moral trajectory.
Gentle direction toward the path supplies the trajectory's orientation.
Endurance supplies continuity of reparative action beyond immediate display.
Repair opposed to corruption identifies what endures.
A deed's consequence returning to its worker supplies outcome reciprocity.
Return to a place or condition supplies the passage's final consequence frame.
The self-protective disposition anchors the cumulative trajectory back in the focus.

structural_cues: 19:76 coordinates increased guidance with enduring reparative acts and evaluates both reward and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, guidance, endurance, repair, and returning recompense; I infer that taqwa is cumulative orientation rather than a bare label. A live alternative is that 19:76 describes only continued confirmation after guidance.

changed_reading.before: Protection in 19:72 is a one-time qualification unrelated to temporal development.
changed_reading.after: Protection is the durable result of increasing guidance and repair, returning to its bearer as extraction when the common field is sorted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates terrain and aggregate senses inside an eschatological judgment clause. It remains anchored in the exact rescue, leaving, and kneeling roots and preserves their syntax; downstream prose should present it only as a spatial-material analogy, not as literal geology or a claim that "جِثِيًّا" ceases to mean kneeling.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "نُنَجِّى ... وَنَذَرُ ... فِيهَا جِثِيًّا" juxtaposes extraction, retention, location, and a root that can image either kneeling bodies or an accumulated mound.

activation_trace.role: High ground beyond a flood supplies an exploratory image of refuge above a common engulfing field.
A separated piece supplies the residual side of material sorting.
An accumulated mound or bodily mass supplies the clustered remainder.

changed_reading.before: Rescue and leaving are only abstract judicial verbs.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the ayah resembles lifting one class onto refuge while the retained class remains accumulated in the engulfed field.

strongest_changes: The exact repetition of kneeling in 19:68 makes it a shared assembly posture; 19:72's decisive contrast is extraction versus remaining.
The mandatory arrival of 19:71 makes rescue subsequent to common approach or exposure, not simple avoidance.
The status comparisons of 19:73-75 turn kneeling into a public reversal of claimed station, assembly, furnishings, and appearance.
summary.what_was_special: The focus becomes procedural rather than merely distributive: repeated focus roots, tightly ordered verbs, and contrasting spatial branches expose a staged sorting in which trajectories remain repairable, arrival is shared, and only retention is differential.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet supports arrival for "وَارِدُهَا" but does not settle precise entry, duration, or intensity.
The shared-posture model depends on how broadly the pronoun group in 19:68 is carried into the universal wording of 19:71.
The topographic-and-heap model is branch-distant and should remain an analogy rather than control the plain kneeling sense.
